summary: Spero Therapeutics filed an 8-K regarding an Open Market Sale Agreement with Jefferies LLC to sell up to $100 million of common stock at-the-market under a universal shelf registration statement. This is a standard equity distribution facility, not a standalone special situation. The filing includes no premium, board recommendation, or structural complexity beyond ordinary ATM mechanics. The at-the-market offering is contingent on the shelf becoming effective. What to Watch: typical ATM issuance, no special-situation angle.
